GatedMetric.description:
One metric the gate rules on, with its non-inferiority margin.

Exactly one of ``margin`` (absolute, in metric units) or ``margin_ratio`` (multiplicative,
for lower-is-better metrics like latency) must be set.

k.description: Which k to gate on for reliability.pass_hat_k.
k.title: K

margin.description: Absolute non-inferiority margin delta_m in the metric's own units.
margin.title: Margin

margin_ratio.description: Multiplicative margin for scale metrics, e.g. 1.25 = 'up to 25% slower'.
margin_ratio.title: Margin Ratio

GatedMetric.title: GatedMetric

allow_self_judging.description: Override the judge/agent family independence rule (D3).
allow_self_judging.title: Allow Self Judging

min_pairs.description: Below this many paired tasks, no verdict is claimed.
min_pairs.title: Min Pairs

normality_alpha.description: Shapiro-Wilk threshold for auto-selecting Wilcoxon over paired t (C2).
normality_alpha.title: Normality Alpha

require_judge_kappa.description: Judge-human agreement floor before a judge may back a gated metric (D4).
require_judge_kappa.title: Require Judge Kappa

safety_tripwires.description: Metrics that fail the gate on any new failure, bypassing statistics.
safety_tripwires.title: Safety Tripwires

underpowered_behavior.description: 'warn' passes an underpowered suite with a banner; 'strict' mode fails it.
underpowered_behavior.title: Underpowered Behavior

use_clustered_se.description: Use cluster-robust SEs when the suite declares clusters.
use_clustered_se.title: Use Clustered Se
